title: A Comprehensive Analysis of European Mythologies

cultures.name: Greek
cultures.deities: The Twelve Olympians led by Zeus on Mount Olympus.
cultures.sources: Foundational works by Homer (Iliad/Odyssey) and Hesiod (Theogony).

cultures.name: Roman
cultures.characteristics: Heavy syncretism with Greek gods; focus on civic virtue and historical foundation myths like Romulus and Remus.

cultures.name: Norse
cultures.cosmology: Nine worlds connected by the world tree Yggdrasil, leading to the prophesied Ragnarök.

cultures.name: Anglo-Saxon
cultures.figures: Woden (Odin), Thunor (Thor), and the concept of Wyrd (Fate).

cultures.name: Slavic
cultures.dualism: The struggle between Perun (Sky/Thunder) and Veles (Underworld/Magic).
cultures.folklore: Figures like the house spirit Domovoi and the witch Baba Yaga.
